dct_description_sm: Biological data collected from specimens of Arctic char from north Labrador are part of a larger International Polar Year program on climate variability and change effects on char in the Arctic. Data are to be used in a comparative manner with information from other regions of Canada to: investigate the response of char to variability in thermal regimes; identify food web relationships of char; examine contaminant levels in samples of resident freshwater and anadromous char; and to assess the genetic and morphological variation among populations of Arctic char.
dct_title_s: Climate Variability and Change (CVC) Effects on Char in the Arctic - Biological Data on Arctic Char from North Labrador
